_doc: Entity names a bq_standard:hunt task may target, and dimensions a location task may use. BQ matches a hunt target against EntityList.stringToClassMapping and never checks it at load, so a wrong name fails silently. Each name was read from the mod's own registration code in the jar (see 'how'); 'summon' records the runtime check: '/qfcensus find <text>' (qf-content) in a server trial lists the keys of EntityList.stringToClassMapping, the map BQ looks targets up in; plain '/summon' cannot take the names with spaces. Add a name here only after checking it the same way.

TwilightForest.Naga.how: TFCreatures.registerTFCreature -> registerModEntity; creatureCompatibility is never set, so no global name
TwilightForest.Naga.summon: present in EntityList.stringToClassMapping, server trial 2026-10-17 (/qfcensus find)

chocolateQuest.pirateBoss.how: ChocolateQuest.class: EntityRegistry.registerModEntity(EntityPirateBoss, "pirateBoss", ...) with modid chocolateQuest (mcmod.info), so FML names it chocolateQuest.pirateBoss; the boss of pirate dungeons (registry MobPirate.getBoss -> new EntityPirateBoss); pack/config/Chocolate/DungeonConfig has two "mob = pirate" dungeons.
